component.name: Simon Image Enhance
component.summary: Lightroom-style photo editor with AI auto correction

description.p: Non-destructive photo editing for JPEG, PNG and camera RAW files.

ul.li: Tone controls and interactive RGB / red / green / blue tone curves
AI correction that sets white balance and tone curves automatically
RAW support via LibRaw, export to JPEG and PNG (8/16 bit)
